description: Route path syntax changed (path-to-regexp 8): wildcards must be named (/*splat), optional segments use braces ({/:id}), and regular-expression characters in string paths are no longer supported
manualAction: Search route strings for `*`, `?`, `+`, `(` and `)`. Rename bare wildcards (`/*` → `/*splat`, access via req.params.splat), turn `/:id?` into `{/:id}`, and replace regex-style paths with explicit routes or RegExp objects.

description: Removed request/response/app signatures: app.del(), req.param(), res.json(obj, status), res.send(body, status), res.send(status), res.redirect(url, status), res.sendfile() and the 'back' redirect/location
manualAction: Use app.delete(), req.params / req.body / req.query, res.status(code).json(obj) / .send(body), res.sendStatus(code), res.redirect(status, url), res.sendFile(), and req.get('Referrer') || '/' instead of 'back'.

description: express.urlencoded(): the `extended` option now defaults to false (querystring instead of qs parsing)
manualAction: Pass `{ extended: true }` explicitly where nested form bodies (a[b]=c) are expected.

description: express.static(): `dotfiles` now defaults to "ignore" and express.static.mime was removed
manualAction: Set `dotfiles: "allow"` where dotfiles (e.g. /.well-known) must be served, and use the mime-types package instead of express.static.mime.

description: req.body is undefined (not {}) when no body parser ran, req.query is read-only, and the default query parser changed from "extended" to "simple"
manualAction: Guard req.body access, stop assigning to req.query, and set `app.set('query parser', 'extended')` if nested query strings (a[b]=c) are relied on.

description: Rejected promises from async middleware/handlers are now forwarded to error-handling middleware
manualAction: Remove express-async-errors / manual try-catch wrappers that only existed to call next(err), and check that error middleware handles the errors now routed to it.
